entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Here you go.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I made various adjustments to the[n]previous drug, based on your trial[n]results.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: All right, drink it down in one gulp.
A powerful taste, both sour and bitter,[n]overwhelms me... The smell is terrible.
I'm having a hard time breathing...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Ah, your reaction to it is absolutely[n]perfect.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You feel a bit dazed, hm? Yes, I mixed in[n]some special... components.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Okay, let's take your temperature and[n]blood pressure. I'm also going to draw[n]some blood.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I also want to perform a few motor skill[n]tests. But those might be too much for[n]you right now.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Anyway, since we're in the final stages,[n]I should first stabilize the fundamental[n]formula...

entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: ...Oh, so you ARE here.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...I'm in the middle of an examination.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I've told you before, Officer. If you want[n]to investigate me, you need to show me[n]a warrant.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Officer
entries.en: Hmph! I'm here because we received[n]a report.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Officer
entries.en: I'll need to see a detailed statement[n]of medical expenses and full medical[n]records.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Officer
entries.en: I bet you didn't have enough time to hide[n]any incriminating documents, huh?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Must be under the orders of[n]the Medical Chief of Staff.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Here you go.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Officer
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: This kid here is my only patient today.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: If you're asking for his medical expenses,[n]I'm guessing I'm under suspicion of[n]improper billing?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: But without a receipt, I'd say you've been[n]sent on a wild goose chase.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Officer
entries.en: Wh-What's going on here?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You're being manipulated. That "report"[n]is fictitious.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It's nothing but an attempt to harass me.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Officer
entries.en: What!?

entries.speaker: Arrogant Officer
entries.en: ...Hey, you! What're you doing here!?

entries.speaker: Arrogant Officer
entries.en: You don't seem to be sick... Are you up to[n]something illegal!?
I have a bad heart.[clr 27]
We're on a date.
I know my rights.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Officer
entries.en: A-A bad heart?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: He's stressed about taking his entrance[n]exams. I have some drugs that help with[n]relaxation.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Officer
entries.en: ...Here? At a clinic?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Uh... We were just about to head out.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Officer
entries.en: Nrgh...!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Do you also have a warrant for disclosure,[n]Officer? If not, I'd be happy to report this.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: So, is there anything else? As you can see,[n]I'm pretty busy here.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Officer
entries.en: ...Fine.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Officer
entries.en: You're infuriating, you know that?[n]Hmph... but I'd expect nothing less[n]from the "Plague."

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: *sigh* I'm so over this...
I agree.[clr 27]
Harassment?
The Plague?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I think we're going to get along just fine.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Ugh...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You couldn't infer the meaning from the[n]conversation? I get so irritated whenever[n]it comes up.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Yeah...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: And could you not say that in front[n]of me? It's a sore subject.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It's nothing to worry about. I'm sure[n]it was my former superior who made[n]that false report.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You eavesdropped on our conversation[n]the other day, remember?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: He's just trying to put pressure on me...[n]by having the police investigate me and[n]my practice.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Anyway, I need to draw some blood.[n]There'll be some mild anemia, but[n]only temporarily. You'll be fine.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...It's part of our "deal," remember?
I guess I have no choice...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I like kids who listen to their superiors.[n]Enjoy your medicine.
It feels like my bond with Takemi[n]is growing even deeper...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'm going to draw more blood than[n]usual... since you're healthy and all...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Only kidding.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Okay, please lie down. You can go[n]home once I'm done.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: All right, take care.
